name: negotiation

tagline_en: Stuck at a hard no? Use tactical empathy, calibrated questions & Ackerman to turn deadlock into deals. BATNA and.
desc_en: Prepare and execute negotiations using tactical empathy, calibrated questions, and the Ackerman method. Use when the user mentions "salary negotiation", "contract terms", "handling objections", "mirroring and labeling", "difficult conversation", "deal terms", "BATNA", "anchoring", "how do I ask for a raise", "get a better deal", or "they wont budge on price". Also trigger when preparing for a vend
why_zh: 同类只给话术，它把谈判拆成可执行的步骤，连对方心理防线怎么破都标好了。
why_en: Others give scripts; this one maps the whole negotiation, including how to breach their psychological defenses.
